lines.speaker: Village Healer
lines.text: Greetings! I'm the village healer. I can restore your health or sell you potions.

lines.speaker: Village Healer
lines.text: I'm currently low on healing herbs. If you bring me some from the fields, I'll reward you handsomely.

lines.speaker: Village Healer
lines.text: Wonderful! Look for the glowing plants in the Eastern Fields.

lines.speaker: Village Healer
lines.text: Of course! Health potions are 25 gold each.

lines.speaker: Village Healer
lines.text: Take care out there. The monsters are getting bolder.
